solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/remove-all-occurrences-of-a-substring/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1910. Remove All Occurrences of a Substring

Given two strings s and part, perform the following operation on s until all occurrences of the substring part are removed:

- Find the leftmost occurrence of the substring part and remove it from s.

Return s after removing all occurrences of part.

A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters in a string.

Example 1:

Input: s = "daabcbaabcbc", part = "abc"
Output: "dab"
Explanation: The following operations are done:
- s = "daabcbaabcbc", remove "abc" starting at index 2, so s = "dabaabcbc".
- s = "dabaabcbc", remove "abc" starting at index 4, so s = "dababc".
- s = "dababc", remove "abc" starting at index 3, so s = "dab".
Now s has no occurrences of "abc".

Example 2:

Input: s = "axxxxyyyyb", part = "xy"
Output: "ab"
Explanation: The following operations are done:
- s = "axxxxyyyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 4 so s = "axxxyyyb".
- s = "axxxyyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 3 so s = "axxyyb".
- s = "axxyyb", remove "xy" starting at index 2 so s = "axyb".
- s = "axyb", remove "xy" starting at index 1 so s = "ab".
Now s has no occurrences of "xy".

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 1000
    1 <= part.length <= 1000
    s and part consist of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def removeOccurrences(self, s: str, part: str) -> str:
        while True:
            idx = s.find(part)
            if idx == -1:
                break
            s = s[:idx] + s[idx + len(part) :]
        return s


sol = Solution()

print(sol.removeOccurrences("daabcbaabcbc", "abc"))  # "dab"

assert sol.removeOccurrences("daabcbaabcbc", "abc") == "dab"
assert sol.removeOccurrences("axxxxyyyyb", "xy") == "ab"

assert sol.removeOccurrences("", "a") == ""
assert sol.removeOccurrences("a", "a") == ""
assert sol.removeOccurrences("aaaaa", "aa") == "a"
assert sol.removeOccurrences("abcabcabc", "abc") == ""
assert sol.removeOccurrences("abcabcabc", "bca") == "abc"
assert sol.removeOccurrences("ababababa", "aba") == "bba"
assert sol.removeOccurrences("xyz", "a") == "xyz"
assert sol.removeOccurrences("a" * 1000, "a") == ""
assert sol.removeOccurrences("ab" * 500, "ab") == ""
assert sol.removeOccurrences("a" * 500 + "b" * 500, "ab") == ""
assert (
    sol.removeOccurrences("abcde" * 200, "cde")
    == ""
)
